name: ghost-in-the-loop
description: Ghost in the Loop — userscript, Firefox extension build, and test harness

scripts.cert:base: npm run cert:preflight && npm run build:extension && npm run check:generated && npm run cert:manifest-audit && npm run cert:artifact-index
scripts.identity:oracle: npm run cert:base && npx jest tests/version.test.js tests/build-identity.test.js --runInBand && npm run identity:check
scripts.package:oracle: npm run package:candidate && npm run package:check
scripts.lint: node --check ghost-in-the-loop.user.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check scripts/certify-extension.js && node --check scripts/build-identity.js && node --check scripts/package-candidate.js
